String.string:
[EN] Use the spell Mutate on a monster.
[ES] Usa el hechizo Mutate en un monstruo.

[EN] When surrounded, use Fear or Stun.
[ES] Cuando estés rodeado, usa Fear o Stun.

[EN] Ghosts are emerging from the coffin. Close the coffin!
[ES] Están saliendo fantasmas del ataúd. ¡Cierra el ataúd!

[EN] To defeat the zomporis, mix a potion into their feast.
[ES] Para derrotar a los zomporis, mezcla una pocion en su festín.

[EN] The blood priest is impervious to damage. Destroy the altar to defeat him.
[ES] El blood priest es inmune al daño. Destruye el altar para derrotarlo.

[EN] You can only damage the altar with Punish.
[ES] Solo puedes dañar el altar con Punish.

[EN] Use spells to destroy the door.
[ES] Usa hechizos para destruir la puerta.

[EN] The blood priest is performing a ritual. Get to the Ceremonial Room and stop him.
[ES] El clérigo de sangre está realizando un ritual. Ve a la Sala Ceremonial y detenlo.

[EN] You have successfully interrupted the Banquet of Blood.
[ES] Has interrumpido con éxito el Banquet of Blood.
